LESSON: THE BIBLE

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The 2.2Bible Story: By the end of the Sub strand, the  Learners to read 1 Samue
Topic 2.3: The Bible

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about The Bible. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. apply lessons learnt from the story of Joseph in their relationship with others 8 ● when he told them about his dream brothers

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. apply lessons learnt from the story of Joseph in their relationship with others 8 ● when he told them about his dream brothers
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to apply lessons learnt from the story of Joseph in their relationship with others 8 ● when he told them about his dream brothers. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about The Bible.
2. Explain The Bible to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand The Bible.
4. Show that you can: apply lessons learnt from the story of Joseph in their relationship with others 8 ● when he told them about his dream brothers
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Bible. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is The Bible important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. apply lessons learnt from the story of Joseph in their relationship with others 8 ● when he told them about his dream brothers

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
